meta.title: Veronika Belousova — Custom digital workspaces for small businesses
meta.description: I design and build custom digital workspaces for small and growing businesses — one place for clients, your team, documents, daily work, and helpful AI tools.

hero.title: Your business doesn't need another app. It needs a system that actually fits.
hero.tagline: I design and build a custom digital workspace for your company — so client details, documents, tasks, and your team live in one place instead of five different tools.
hero.support: Built around how your business already works. Not the other way around.
hero.role: Founder · builds custom workspaces for small businesses

problem.label: Sound familiar?
problem.heading: When tools don't talk to each other, work gets messy
problem.intro: If your team spends the day jumping between chats, spreadsheets, email, and folders — this is for you.

items.title: Client info is scattered
items.detail: One person has the notes in WhatsApp. Another has files in Drive. Someone else updated a spreadsheet last week. Finding the truth takes too long.

items.title: The same details get typed again
items.detail: Names, dates, and documents are re-entered into forms and messages. Small mistakes slip in, and the day fills with busywork.

items.title: Hand-offs break
items.detail: When a colleague takes over a client, context is missing. Customers feel it — and your team feels the stress.

items.title: Routine steps stay manual
items.detail: Reminders, status checks, and simple follow-ups still depend on someone remembering. Things get delayed.

capabilities.label: What you receive
capabilities.heading: A workspace built for your company — not a one-size product
capabilities.intro: You don't buy a fixed package. We pick the pieces your business needs first, then add more only when they help.

items.title: One digital home for the business
items.detail: A shared place your team logs into every day — with the screens and roles that match how you actually work.

items.title: Client records (and a client area if needed)
items.detail: Keep client details organised in one record. If useful, give clients a simple place to see status or share documents.

items.title: Documents in the right order
items.detail: Files stay attached to the right client and move through your real steps — review, approve, send — without hunting folders.

items.title: Clear ownership of work
items.detail: Tasks show who is doing what, what's waiting, and what is done — so nothing important disappears into a chat thread.

items.title: Team chat and video in context
items.detail: When it helps, conversation and meetings sit next to the client or project — so people stop switching apps for every update.

items.title: Helpful AI for everyday work
items.detail: Practical help with drafts, summaries, sorting, or document review — used carefully, where it saves time, not as a gimmick.

items.title: Connect tools you already use
items.detail: Where it makes sense, we link the software you already rely on, so you are not forced to replace everything on day one.

whyCustom.label: Why custom
whyCustom.heading: Ready-made software is fine — until it fights your process
whyCustom.intro: Many businesses can run on standard tools. Custom work is for when those tools force awkward workarounds, extra spreadsheets, or constant copying between systems.

items.title: Fitted to your real process
items.detail: We start from how your team already serves customers — then build the workspace to support that flow.

items.title: Start small, grow on purpose
items.detail: Launch with the first problem that hurts most. Add the next module when the team is ready.

items.title: Change without freezing the business
items.detail: We roll out in stages so daily work continues while the new system takes over piece by piece.

items.title: Keep what still works
items.detail: If an existing tool is doing its job, we keep it in the picture whenever connecting it is practical.

caseStudy.label: Example project
caseStudy.heading: SPIORA: a custom workspace for an immigration services business
caseStudy.context: An immigration services team needs accurate client records, careful document handling, and clear hand-offs between people. As the caseload grows, spreadsheets and disconnected chats stop being enough.
caseStudy.solution: SPIORA is a custom digital workspace built around that company's way of working — one place for client work, team coordination, and practical AI help. It is not a generic product sold the same way to every business.
caseStudy.capabilitiesNote: Based on the built product. Some extras (like video meetings) can be turned on when the environment is ready.

process.label: How engagement works
process.heading: Discovery → first scoped solution → launch → optional expansion
process.intro: You always know the stage we are in, what you will get next, and what we are checking before we go further.

steps.title: 1. Discovery
steps.detail: We talk through how your business works today: who does what, which tools you use, and where time and mistakes pile up.

steps.title: 2. First scoped solution
steps.detail: We agree a focused first version — clear screens, roles, and outcomes — so you know exactly what will be built before full development.

steps.title: 3. Launch
steps.detail: We build, test with real workflows, and go live carefully: access, roles, and a handoff your team can run.

steps.title: 4. Optional expansion & support
steps.detail: After launch we can add the next module, fix friction, and keep supporting the workspace as your business changes.

about.label: About
about.heading: I listen first — then build the system around your business
paragraphs: I trained as a journalist. That still shapes how I work: ask clear questions, listen carefully, and find the real process behind the request — not just the surface symptoms.
I moved into product and building software because growing teams need more than another disconnected app. They need a digital workspace that matches how people actually collaborate.
Today I design and build custom platforms for small and growing businesses. The goal is simple: something your team can use every day, with practical AI only where it genuinely helps.

items.a: A working digital workspace for your team — starting with a focused first version that solves a real daily problem (for example client records, documents, or task flow). We agree the scope in writing before build.
Roles, screens, workflows, client-facing areas, document steps, automations, and where AI is used — limited to what your business needs now.

items.q: Can you connect tools we already use?
items.a: Often yes, when those tools allow a reliable connection. We check this early so you know what is realistic.

items.q: How does a project usually start?
items.a: With a discovery conversation, then a scoped first solution, then build and launch. Expansion and ongoing support are optional after you are live.

items.q: Do you support the system after launch?
items.a: Yes, if we agree. That can include fixes, small improvements, and the next modules so the workspace stays useful.

items.q: How do you handle security and privacy?
items.a: Access is based on roles. Stronger login options are available when needed. Private customer data is not used in marketing materials or public demos.
